subject: Taxes
title: Global Information Sharing
description: Learn Global Information Sharing in one minute.

hook.text: Over 100 countries now automatically share bank account data with each other.

buildup.text: FATCA (2010) forces foreign banks to report American accounts. CRS (2014) extends this globally.

discovery.text: Since FATCA launched, voluntary disclosures of hidden offshore accounts generated $11 billion in back taxes.

twist.text: But some countries refuse to join. The US itself doesn't participate in CRS—demanding transparency it won't reciprocate.

climax.text: Global information sharing is ending the era of offshore secrecy.

punchline.text: 100 countries share data. The US demands it but won't give its own.

quiz.question: What is the biggest gap in global tax information sharing?
options: The US demands data from others but doesn't reciprocate under CRS
